messages:
maya: Quick sync — SW Summit joint session with NebulaCloud + OptiGPU. Need final speaker list, demo order, and swag packing list. 30m slot on Day 2. Who can take what?

danielle: I can own speaker logistics (talk transport + slides). Do we have confirmation from Nebula on headcount?

kevin: I talked to Ezra yesterday — Nebula confirmed two speakers: @ezra_nebula (platform lead) and Lina (solutions eng). OptiGPU sending a field engineer (Tariq).

raj: For demos, recommend: 1) quick 3-min intro (branding), 2) 12-min live inference demo (Redwood + OptiGPU HW), 3) 10-min customer Q&A + partner plug. That fits 30 with Qs.

sophie: Agree. Need to lock demo data + network setup for on-site kit. Can someone confirm we have VPC passthrough and local weights?

kevin: @sophie — OptiGPU will bring a prebuilt kit (image on USB). We still need to test model load times on their card. I'll run end-to-end test next Tue.

maya: Cool. Speaker roster so far: Maya (partnerships) — 3 min intro? Danielle — host/MC. Kevin — demo lead. Ezra + Lina (Nebula) — partner segment. Tariq (OptiGPU) — HW deep dive. Any objections?

ezra_nebula: All good from Nebula side. Can we add a 60s clip highlighting our marketplace listing? We have updated screenshots.

danielle: Yes — slot 1 can include the marketplace mention. Need assets by Friday EOD. @maya can you coordinate?

maya: On it. I'll compile assets and send to @danielle by Thu noon. Also coordinating cue cards / slide templates.

kevin: Run-of-show draft (will refine):
```
00:00 - 03:00 Intro / market context (maya)
03:00 - 06:00 Marketplace mention + partner shout (nebula)
06:00 - 18:00 Live demo (kevin + tariq)
18:00 - 27:00 Tech deep-dive (nebula + optigpu)
27:00 - 30:00 Q&A + CTA / swag mention
```

raj: That looks good. For live demo checklist:
- preloaded model on OptiGPU image
- network fallback to hosted Redwood API in case of local perf issues
- demo dataset stored locally (no internet)
- run rehearsal with all speakers (dry run)

sophie: I'll book a rehearsal slot with AV for Wed afternoon. Please hold 45m.

maya: Swag plan: sticker pack, one-page quickstart postcard, and a small clip-on bag. Need counts — how many partner attendees vs booth visitors?

ezra_nebula: Expected audience ~150. Nebula will bring 100 co-branded stickers. Can Redwood cover 200 postcards + 150 clip-bags?

maya: Budget check — ops will confirm. @ops-bot can you action a swag PO for 350 postcards + 150 clip-bags and add co-brand printing?

ops-bot: PO request recorded: swag-PO-7821. Estimated lead time 7 business days. Confirm with procurement channel: #finance-procurement.

danielle: Also need speaker bios (1-2 lines) + headshots for the event page. Please drop in the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/integrations/sw-summit-assets

kevin: Rehearsal checklist (short):
- test GPU image boot + model load (10m)
- verify token routing to hosted fallback (5m)
- slides + video playback check (5m)
- mic + stage timing (10m)

maya: I'll set the calendar invites after Sophie confirms AV. Final action items:
- @danielle: collect bios + confirm MC script.
- @kevin: run E2E test Tue, share logs.
- @sophie: book AV rehearsal Wed.
- @ezra_nebula: send marketplace screenshot + 60s clip by Fri.
- @ops-bot: swag PO submitted — follow up in procurement.

maya: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene after the rehearsal and lock the final slides. :thumbsup:
